interpretation: No exact DICOM SeriesInstanceUID or StudyInstanceUID used by the frozen ten-anatomy M4 confirmatory cohort appears in the audited 80-subject M6 challenge surface.
This establishes identity non-overlap for the frozen M4 cohort; it does not by itself establish independence of institutions, acquisition mechanisms, or populations.
The NCI-ISBI challenge remains a different TCIA analysis substrate from M4, while leaderboard/test subjects remain same-challenge robustness reserve rather than a separate external dataset.
